max.description: Maximum position of the bounds of the collision box. [16, 16, 16] is the top-right of the cube.
max.x-runtime-constraint-description: There are different constraints for different indexes, please refer to member help for more details

min.description: Minimal position of the bounds of the collision box. [0, 0, 0] is the bottom-left of the cube.
min.x-runtime-constraint-description: There are different constraints for different indexes, please refer to member help for more details

origin.description: Minimal position of the bounds of the collision box. [0, 0, 0] is the bottom-center of the cube.
origin.x-runtime-constraint-description: There are different constraints for different indexes, please refer to member help for more details

size.description: Size of each side of the collision box.
